scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace apps/web" "npm run dev --workspace apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/api
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run start --workspace apps/web" "npm run start --workspace apps/api"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/web && npm run lint --workspace apps/api
